_comment: Worked example: one sealed, layered compartment; four 1.25-year injection periods then 5 years shut-in (config/demo.yaml). Assumed generic deep-saline-aquifer values - not a real site. The closed-form reference rate of this reservoir is 2.75 kg/s, so the mean rate of 4 kg/s is 1.45x q_ref, inside the training design (0.15-4x).
